reference.task144Reading: A callback->SENT P50 56769/59317ms net 15.20/14.73 rows/s; B P50 19782/18306ms net 35.59/37.25 rows/s; comparability gate failed (A1 QPS -15.65%, 2 consume failures) -> UNDETERMINED, default unchanged

verdict.reason: TASK-145 only measures; two rounds cannot establish a reproducible gain, and the two arms are not comparable (submit QPS A 153.45 vs B 190.15, +23.9%; different wall and P50). Even though B is faster in this bounded burst, relay-interval-ms stays 5000 and no sustained-throughput improvement is claimed.

comparability.sameSourceStageDirectionalNote: pub->consume P50 close (A 10616 / B 9938) while callback->SENT differs hugely (A 58008 / B 19343.5) -> the gap concentrates in the relay segment, not the MQ segment; not used for any default change
comparability.strongestCounterexample: B flattened the creation burst into small dense batches, so no A-style '100-row batch + 6.3s gap' pulse appeared; but the burst window only sent 142 rows and 1868 rows still relied on full-batch draining. So 'B is faster' holds only for this bounded burst and does NOT prove no sustained backlog at the observed creation rate (87-96 rows/s >> B's 37 rows/s).
